metric: Transactions per store YoY, store vs its matched peer stores
baseline_concept: The store's own gap to its peers over the previous 13 weeks
threshold_concept: A step change in the gap that persists (change-point test as in Phase 6); size and persistence rules to be calibrated
required_response: Area manager checks for a local or operational change within one week; investigation opened if unexplained
motivated_by: I1: the cluster loss was found at half-year; a weekly check could flag a similar step within weeks

threshold_concept: Sustained move beyond the normal weekly range; to be calibrated
required_response: Review at the weekly trading meeting

metric: Availability by category and by supplier
baseline_concept: Same weeks last year and the previous 8 weeks
threshold_concept: Below both baselines for 4 consecutive weeks (concept); to be calibrated
required_response: Replenishment review of the affected supplier's SKUs
motivated_by: I2: Electronics availability fell over H2 2025

metric: Full-week stock-outs and weeks of cover on the top 10% of SKUs by sales
baseline_concept: Prior-year level for the same SKUs
threshold_concept: Any top-seller SKU with a full-week stock-out in 2 consecutive weeks (concept)
required_response: Expedite or rebalance stock; log the cause
motivated_by: I2: lost sales concentrate in a few high-selling SKUs

metric: 'Faulty' returned units per 100 sold, by store, supplier and sale month
threshold_concept: Rate increase unlikely under the prior-year rate (a conditional binomial test as in Phase 6); significance level and minimum volume to be set
required_response: Hold returns for inspection in the flagged store; check recording practice
motivated_by: I4: 'Faulty' returns concentrated in five stores

threshold_concept: A step down that persists for 4 weeks (concept); to be calibrated
required_response: Split into price, mix, promotion and cost effects
motivated_by: I5: Home & Kitchen margin fell with deeper promotions

metric: Discount rate, promotion share and promotion events by category
baseline_concept: The approved promotion plan (once DR29 exists); prior year until then
threshold_concept: Actual above plan by an agreed tolerance (to be set by Commercial)
required_response: Check the promotion has an objective and a review (A18)

metric: Receipts per store-day and returns per store-day against expected ranges; missing snapshots
baseline_concept: Same weekday over the previous 8 weeks
threshold_concept: Zero or near-zero counts on a trading day (concept)
required_response: Check the data feed before anyone reads the dashboard
motivated_by: All issues: monitoring is only as good as the feed (and A01 checks this for the cluster)
